attribution.description: Official national carbon-intensity forecasts and estimated actuals; collector maintained independently
attribution.endorsement: No provider endorsement or affiliation is implied

detail: Collecting NESO forecasts for the first half-hour starting at least 24 hours after receipt. Actuals resolve no earlier than 48 hours after target end. Issued time is our receipt time; no candidate predictor is being evaluated. Missed counts are unobserved nominal run slots, not verified scheduler failures.
evidence: Local capture records; GitHub publication time must be established separately

health.slot_interpretation: Latest nominal UTC slot at actual run start; queued scheduler event times are not reconstructed

maturity_rule: first observed non-null national actual at least 48h after target end
provenance: Local capture records; GitHub publication time must be established separately
target_rule: first UTC half-hour start >= receipt+24h; actual lead in [24h,24.5h)
